_readme: A school's data file. One JSON object; this is the only route data takes into a deployment.
Load it on the School Data screen, or with: node server/provision.js import <file>.
The importer refuses the file on any error and lists warnings without blocking.
Keys beginning with an underscore are ignored, so these notes can stay in the file.
A full export from a running deployment (Settings -> Full backup) has exactly this shape,
which is what makes a backup enough to re-create a school on a new deployment.

school._note: name is required. yearStart, yearWorkingDays and minAttendance drive the eligibility forecast.
school.name: Example Higher Secondary School

_accounts: Sign-ins created at import. Existing usernames are left alone, so re-importing
never resets a password someone has already changed. Passwords are hashed with
scrypt on arrival and the plaintext is not stored. Roles: admin, principal,
teacher, accountant, parent, student. Give parent and student accounts a sid.
_students: id, name and cls are required; every id must be unique.
cls is a Roman numeral I–XII. community is OC/BC/BCM/MBC/SC/ST. medium is Tamil or English.
group applies to Std XI–XII only: Bio-Maths, Pure Science, Computer Science, Commerce, Vocational.
attPresent and attTotal are aggregates; the day-by-day series lives in attHistory.
income, firstGraduate, cwsn, community and rte are what the scholarship matcher reads —
leave them out and a child simply will not match the schemes that depend on them.
_staff: The staff register. id and name are what the portal lists on; the rest is shown on the Staff screen.
_attDays: Every working day the attendance history covers, oldest first, as YYYY-MM-DD.
attHistory[studentId] must hold exactly one character per entry here, or the import is refused.
_attHistory: One character per working day: P present, A absent, L late (late counts as present).
_marks: Keyed studentId|term|subject. Terms: Unit Test 1, Quarterly, Half-Yearly, Unit Test 2, Model Exam, Annual.
_receipts: Fee receipts already issued, so the collection register and dues open with the right totals.
_notices: Circulars shown on the notice board.
_attendance: Day registers already marked, keyed date|class|section. Usually empty at import.
_applications: Admission applications in progress. Usually empty at import.
